title: firebase/firebase-ios-sdk
title_zh: Firebase 苹果 SDK 开源仓库

paragraphs.en: CocoaPods: New versions of the Firebase Apple SDK will no longer be published to CocoaPods after October 2026 . Existing CocoaPods versions will remain available and installations will remain functional. See the migration guide for more information.
paragraphs.zh: CocoaPods：自 2026 年 10 月之后，Firebase Apple SDK 的新版本将不再发布到 CocoaPods。 现有的 CocoaPods 版本仍将可用，安装功能仍可正常使用。 有关更多信息，请参阅迁移指南。

sents.en: CocoaPods: New versions of the Firebase Apple SDK will no longer be published to CocoaPods after October 2026 .
sents.zh: CocoaPods：自 2026 年 10 月之后，Firebase Apple SDK 的新版本将不再发布到 CocoaPods。

sents.en: Existing CocoaPods versions will remain available and installations will remain functional.
sents.zh: 现有的 CocoaPods 版本仍将可用，安装功能仍可正常使用。

sents.en: See the migration guide for more information.
sents.zh: 有关更多信息，请参阅迁移指南。

paragraphs.en: Preview Release: Firebase AI Logic's Gemini Foundation Models framework adapter is now available in preview. Get started by visiting the documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 预览版发布：Firebase AI Logic 的 Gemini 基础模型框架适配器现已推出预览版。 请访问文档以开始使用。

sents.en: Preview Release: Firebase AI Logic's Gemini Foundation Models framework adapter is now available in preview.
sents.zh: 预览版发布：Firebase AI Logic 的 Gemini 基础模型框架适配器现已推出预览版。

sents.en: Get started by visiting the documentation .
sents.zh: 请访问文档以开始使用。

paragraphs.en: This repository contains the source code for all Apple platform Firebase libraries except FirebaseAnalytics .
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库包含除 FirebaseAnalytics 之外的所有 Apple 平台 Firebase 库的源代码。

paragraphs.en: Firebase is an app development platform with libraries, services, and tools to help you build, grow, and monetize your app. Learn more about Firebase at the official Firebase website .
paragraphs.zh: Firebase 是一个应用开发平台，提供各类库、服务和工具，帮助你构建、发展你的应用并从中盈利。 你可以在 Firebase 官方网站上进一步了解 Firebase。

sents.en: Firebase is an app development platform with libraries, services, and tools to help you build, grow, and monetize your app.
sents.zh: Firebase 是一个应用开发平台，提供各类库、服务和工具，帮助你构建、发展你的应用并从中盈利。

sents.en: Learn more about Firebase at the official Firebase website .
sents.zh: 你可以在 Firebase 官方网站上进一步了解 Firebase。

paragraphs.en: The following products are open-source and included in this repository:
paragraphs.zh: 以下产品均为开源产品，并已包含在本仓库中：

paragraphs.en: Firebase Analytics is not open-source, but its pre-compiled binaries are included when installing Firebase via Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods.
paragraphs.zh: Firebase Analytics 并非开源，但通过 Swift Package Manager 或 CocoaPods 安装 Firebase 时会包含其预编译的二进制文件。

paragraphs.en: See the subsections below for details about the different installation methods. Where available, it's recommended to install libraries with a Swift suffix to get the best experience when writing your app in Swift.
paragraphs.zh: 有关不同安装方法的详细信息，请参阅下文各小节。 在可用的情况下，建议安装带有 Swift 后缀的库，以便在使用 Swift 编写应用时获得最佳体验。

sents.en: See the subsections below for details about the different installation methods.
sents.zh: 有关不同安装方法的详细信息，请参阅下文各小节。

sents.en: Where available, it's recommended to install libraries with a Swift suffix to get the best experience when writing your app in Swift.
sents.zh: 在可用的情况下，建议安装带有 Swift 后缀的库，以便在使用 Swift 编写应用时获得最佳体验。

paragraphs.en: Find instructions for installing using Swift Package Manager in the Firebase get started documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 Firebase 入门文档，查找有关使用 Swift Package Manager 进行安装的说明。

paragraphs.en: Find instructions for installing with CocoaPods ( pod install ) in the Firebase installation options documentation .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Firebase 安装选项文档中查找使用 CocoaPods（pod install）进行安装的说明。

paragraphs.en: Note: To accommodate the read-only announcement from CocoaPods, Firebase will stop publishing new versions to CocoaPods in October 2026. Learn more.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：为配合 CocoaPods 的只读公告，Firebase 将于 2026 年 10 月起停止向 CocoaPods 发布新版本。了解更多。

paragraphs.en: You can install from GitHub to access the Firebase repo at other branches, tags, or commits.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以从 GitHub 安装，以访问其他分支、标签或提交上的 Firebase 代码库。

paragraphs.en: For instructions and options about overriding pod source locations, see the Podfile Syntax Reference .
paragraphs.zh: 有关覆盖 pod 源位置的说明和选项，请参阅 Podfile 语法参考。

paragraphs.en: All official releases are tagged in this repo and available via CocoaPods. To access a local source snapshot or unreleased branch, use Podfile directives. Here are some example directives which use FirebaseFirestore as the example library.
paragraphs.zh: 所有正式版本都在此仓库中打了标签，并可通过 CocoaPods 获取。 如需访问本地源码快照或未发布的分支，请使用 Podfile 指令。 下面是一些示例指令，其中以 FirebaseFirestore 作为示例库。

sents.en: All official releases are tagged in this repo and available via CocoaPods.
sents.zh: 所有正式版本都在此仓库中打了标签，并可通过 CocoaPods 获取。

sents.en: To access a local source snapshot or unreleased branch, use Podfile directives.
sents.zh: 如需访问本地源码快照或未发布的分支，请使用 Podfile 指令。

sents.en: Here are some example directives which use FirebaseFirestore as the example library.
sents.zh: 下面是一些示例指令，其中以 FirebaseFirestore 作为示例库。

paragraphs.en: To access FirebaseFirestore via a branch :
paragraphs.zh: 要通过分支（branch）访问 FirebaseFirestore：

paragraphs.en: pod 'FirebaseCore' , :git => 'https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk.git' , :branch => 'main' pod 'FirebaseFirestore' , :git => 'https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk.git' , :branch => 'main' To access FirebaseFirestore via a checked-out version of the firebase-ios-sdk repo:
paragraphs.zh: pod 'FirebaseCore' , :git => 'https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk.git' , :branch => 'main' pod 'FirebaseFirestore' , :git => 'https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk.git' , :branch => 'main' 要通过已检出的 firebase-ios-sdk 仓库版本来访问 FirebaseFirestore：

paragraphs.en: pod 'FirebaseCore' , :path => '/path/to/firebase-ios-sdk' pod 'FirebaseFirestore' , :path => '/path/to/firebase-ios-sdk' Carthage (iOS only) Find instructions for the experimental Carthage distribution (iOS only) at Carthage.md within this repo.
paragraphs.zh: pod 'FirebaseCore' , :path => '/path/to/firebase-ios-sdk' pod 'FirebaseFirestore' , :path => '/path/to/firebase-ios-sdk' Carthage（仅限 iOS）有关实验性 Carthage 发行版（仅限 iOS）的说明，请参阅本仓库中的 Carthage.md。

paragraphs.en: Find details about using Firebase from a Framework or a library at firebase_in_libraries.md within this repo.
paragraphs.zh: 如需了解在框架或库中使用 Firebase 的详细信息，请参阅本仓库中的 firebase_in_libraries.md。

paragraphs.en: Firebase provides official beta support for macOS, Catalyst, and tvOS. visionOS and watchOS are community supported. Thanks to community contributions for many of the multi-platform PRs.
paragraphs.zh: Firebase 为 macOS、Catalyst 和 tvOS 提供官方测试版支持，visionOS 和 watchOS 由社区提供支持。 感谢社区为众多多平台 PR 做出的贡献。

sents.en: Firebase provides official beta support for macOS, Catalyst, and tvOS. visionOS and watchOS are community supported.
sents.zh: Firebase 为 macOS、Catalyst 和 tvOS 提供官方测试版支持，visionOS 和 watchOS 由社区提供支持。

sents.en: Thanks to community contributions for many of the multi-platform PRs.
sents.zh: 感谢社区为众多多平台 PR 做出的贡献。

paragraphs.en: At this time, most Firebase products are available across Apple platforms. There are still a few gaps, especially on visionOS and watchOS. For details about the current support matrix, see this chart in the Firebase documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，大多数 Firebase 产品在 Apple 各平台上均可用。 仍存在少量缺口，尤其是在 visionOS 和 watchOS 上。 有关当前支持矩阵的详细信息，请参阅 Firebase 文档中的此图表。

sents.en: At this time, most Firebase products are available across Apple platforms.
sents.zh: 目前，大多数 Firebase 产品在 Apple 各平台上均可用。

sents.en: There are still a few gaps, especially on visionOS and watchOS.
sents.zh: 仍存在少量缺口，尤其是在 visionOS 和 watchOS 上。

sents.en: For details about the current support matrix, see this chart in the Firebase documentation.
sents.zh: 有关当前支持矩阵的详细信息，请参阅 Firebase 文档中的此图表。

paragraphs.en: Where supported, visionOS works as expected with the exception of Firestore via Swift Package Manager where it is required to use the source distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 在受支持的情况下，visionOS 可按预期正常工作，但通过 Swift Package Manager 使用 Firestore 除外，此时必须使用源代码发行版。

paragraphs.en: To enable the Firestore source distribution, quit Xcode and open the desired project from the command line with the FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE environment variable: open --env FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE /path/to/project.xcodeproj . To go back to using the binary distribution of Firestore, quit Xcode and open Xcode like normal, without the environment variable.
paragraphs.zh: 要启用 Firestore 源码分发，请退出 Xcode，并在命令行中通过 FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE 环境变量打开目标项目：open --env FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE /path/to/project.xcodeproj 。 要改回使用 Firestore 的二进制分发，请退出 Xcode，然后不带该环境变量、像平常一样打开 Xcode。

sents.en: To enable the Firestore source distribution, quit Xcode and open the desired project from the command line with the FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE environment variable: open --env FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE /path/to/project.xcodeproj .
sents.zh: 要启用 Firestore 源码分发，请退出 Xcode，并在命令行中通过 FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE 环境变量打开目标项目：open --env FIREBASE_SOURCE_FIRESTORE /path/to/project.xcodeproj 。

sents.en: To go back to using the binary distribution of Firestore, quit Xcode and open Xcode like normal, without the environment variable.
sents.zh: 要改回使用 Firestore 的二进制分发，请退出 Xcode，然后不带该环境变量、像平常一样打开 Xcode。

paragraphs.en: Thanks to contributions from the community, many of Firebase SDKs now compile, run unit tests, and work on watchOS. See the Independent Watch App Sample .
paragraphs.zh: 感谢社区的贡献，许多 Firebase SDK 现在可以在 watchOS 上编译、运行单元测试并正常工作。 请参阅独立 Watch 应用示例。

sents.en: Thanks to contributions from the community, many of Firebase SDKs now compile, run unit tests, and work on watchOS.
sents.zh: 感谢社区的贡献，许多 Firebase SDK 现在可以在 watchOS 上编译、运行单元测试并正常工作。

sents.en: See the Independent Watch App Sample .
sents.zh: 请参阅独立 Watch 应用示例。

paragraphs.en: Keep in mind that watchOS is not officially supported by Firebase. While we can catch basic unit test issues with GitHub Actions, there may be some changes where the SDK no longer works as expected on watchOS. If you encounter this, please file an issue .
paragraphs.zh: 请记住，Firebase 并未正式支持 watchOS。 虽然我们可以通过 GitHub Actions 发现基本的单元测试问题，但仍可能存在一些变更导致 SDK 在 watchOS 上不再按预期工作。 如果遇到这种情况，请提交一个 issue。

sents.en: Keep in mind that watchOS is not officially supported by Firebase.
sents.zh: 请记住，Firebase 并未正式支持 watchOS。

sents.en: While we can catch basic unit test issues with GitHub Actions, there may be some changes where the SDK no longer works as expected on watchOS.
sents.zh: 虽然我们可以通过 GitHub Actions 发现基本的单元测试问题，但仍可能存在一些变更导致 SDK 在 watchOS 上不再按预期工作。

sents.en: If you encounter this, please file an issue .
sents.zh: 如果遇到这种情况，请提交一个 issue。

paragraphs.en: During app setup in the console, you may get to a step that mentions something like "Checking if the app has communicated with our servers". This relies on FirebaseAnalytics and will not work on watchOS. It's safe to ignore the message and continue , the rest of the SDKs will work as expected.
paragraphs.zh: 在控制台中进行应用设置时，你可能会看到类似「正在检查应用是否已与我们的服务器通信」的步骤。 这依赖于 FirebaseAnalytics，在 watchOS 上无法正常工作。 可以安全地忽略该消息并继续，其余的 SDK 将按预期正常工作。

sents.en: During app setup in the console, you may get to a step that mentions something like "Checking if the app has communicated with our servers".
sents.zh: 在控制台中进行应用设置时，你可能会看到类似「正在检查应用是否已与我们的服务器通信」的步骤。

sents.en: This relies on FirebaseAnalytics and will not work on watchOS.
sents.zh: 这依赖于 FirebaseAnalytics，在 watchOS 上无法正常工作。

sents.en: It's safe to ignore the message and continue , the rest of the SDKs will work as expected.
sents.zh: 可以安全地忽略该消息并继续，其余的 SDK 将按预期正常工作。

paragraphs.en: Using Crashlytics with watchOS has limited support. Due to watchOS restrictions, mach exceptions and signal crashes are not recorded. (Crashes in SwiftUI are generated as mach exceptions, so will not be recorded).
paragraphs.zh: 在 watchOS 上使用 Crashlytics 的支持有限。 由于 watchOS 的限制，mach 异常和信号崩溃不会被记录。 （SwiftUI 中的崩溃是以 mach 异常形式生成的，因此不会被记录）。

sents.en: Using Crashlytics with watchOS has limited support.
sents.zh: 在 watchOS 上使用 Crashlytics 的支持有限。

sents.en: Due to watchOS restrictions, mach exceptions and signal crashes are not recorded.
sents.zh: 由于 watchOS 的限制，mach 异常和信号崩溃不会被记录。

sents.en: (Crashes in SwiftUI are generated as mach exceptions, so will not be recorded).
sents.zh: （SwiftUI 中的崩溃是以 mach 异常形式生成的，因此不会被记录）。

paragraphs.en: Thanks to contributions from the community, FirebaseCombineSwift contains support for Apple's Combine framework. This module is currently under development and not yet supported for use in production environments. For more details, see the docs within this repo.
paragraphs.zh: 感谢社区的贡献，FirebaseCombineSwift 已包含对 Apple Combine 框架的支持。 该模块目前仍在开发中，尚未支持在生产环境中使用。 更多详情，请参阅本仓库中的文档。

sents.en: Thanks to contributions from the community, FirebaseCombineSwift contains support for Apple's Combine framework.
sents.zh: 感谢社区的贡献，FirebaseCombineSwift 已包含对 Apple Combine 框架的支持。

sents.en: This module is currently under development and not yet supported for use in production environments.
sents.zh: 该模块目前仍在开发中，尚未支持在生产环境中使用。

sents.en: For more details, see the docs within this repo.
sents.zh: 更多详情，请参阅本仓库中的文档。

paragraphs.en: See Roadmap for more about the Firebase Apple SDK Open Source plans and directions.
paragraphs.zh: 有关 Firebase Apple SDK 开源计划与方向的更多信息，请查看路线图（Roadmap）。

paragraphs.en: For information on how to contribute, set up the development environment, build, or test the SDK, see the Contributing Guide .
paragraphs.zh: 有关如何贡献、设置开发环境、构建或测试 SDK 的信息，请参阅贡献指南（Contributing Guide）。
